mechanism.claim: During an already volatile BTC block, unusually lower ordinal-path entropy in Binance spot than in the perpetual identifies more structured cash price discovery rather than derivatives noise. When completed spot and perpetual returns agree, follow their common direction for twelve hours at the fresh entropy-leadership onset.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of completed four-hour spot and perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: Prior spot sponsorship candidates used quote turnover, execution counts, taker imbalance, or relative return magnitude. The prior ordinal classifier used one perpetual path and fitted outcome labels. HVSPPE uses no flow, volume, trade count, ticket size, fitted model, prior event set, or promoted control: it compares normalized Bandt-Pompe ordinal-pattern entropy across the cash and perpetual paths.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fresh cross-market complexity-leadership onsets at four-hour boundaries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.sources: 240 exact aligned coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows from bars_binance_spot and bars_binance over [T-4h,T)
features.five_minute_paths: 48 exact nonoverlapping groups per venue; each close is the fifth constituent minute close
features.ordinal_patterns: all 46 consecutive triples of five-minute closes, dimension 3 and delay 1; ties resolve deterministically by earlier temporal index
features.normalized_permutation_entropy: negative sum over six pattern probabilities p*log(p), divided by log(6), independently by venue
features.entropy_leadership: perpetual entropy minus spot entropy, finite strict nonzero; positive means spot is more ordinally ordered
features.entropy_leadership_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.returns: log(last five-minute close/first five-minute close) independently by venue; both strict nonzero and same sign
features.perpetual_variation: sqrt(sum squared 47 perpetual five-minute close-to-close log returns), finite strict positive
features.eligible_state: positive entropy leadership, entropy rank and variation rank pass, and venue return directions agree
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior source-valid decision ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published cryptocurrency permutation-entropy complexity applied as a cross-market cash-leadership mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no embedding dimension, tie convention, entropy rank, variation rank, direction agreement, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Bandt-Pompe permutation entropy applied to cryptocurrency efficiency
external_basis.support: ordinal-pattern permutation entropy quantifies cryptocurrency price-series efficiency and temporal ordering
external_basis.selection_use: fixed dimension-three normalized permutation entropy only; cross-market difference, ranks, direction and holding application are untested; no incidence or outcomes
